verdict.rationale: Justworks is a PEO and payroll/HR SaaS, not an AI agent or assistant that acts as an MCP client. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can use their tools is outside its category. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI agent or MCP-client capability that would make this axis apply; the pack covers only payroll, benefits, time off and the Xero integration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
